report.outcome: Done. The bug in `buildIndex` was that records were keyed by the raw `record.id` rather than the normalized id. I fixed it by keying the Map with `normalizeId(record.id)`; since iteration proceeds in input order and `Map.set` overwrites existing keys, the latest record naturally wins for any id that normalizes to the same key. Both public exports (`buildIndex` and the re-exported `normalizeId`) are preserved, no dependency was added, and no other files were changed. Test run: `node:test` reports 1 test passed, 0 failed — including the assertions that `' User-1 '` and `'user-1'` collapse to the `user-1` key with the newer record stored, and `'USER-2'` maps to `user-2`.
